coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Eight of nine ground-truth variable categories are represented: weight-only quantization, WikiText-2 at length 2048, an unquantized FP16 baseline, the three LLaMA-2 sizes, 2/3/4-bit weights, all four method combinations, perplexity, and numerical-failure monitoring. This gives 89% after rounding.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The quantization scheme is not held constant: per-group quantization is varied alongside per-column quantization instead of using per-column asymmetric quantization throughout. The output also adds LLaMA-3, other evaluation datasets, and extra outcomes. FP16/BF16 alternatives weaken the fixed-FP16 controls, and KV-cache precision is not explicitly specified.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the supplied results and conclusions.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion reports the QuaRot-GPTQ improvements, low-bit RTN failures, limited stabilization of RTN, or the 70B W2 perplexity reduction from 25.30 to 5.60.
